request.prompt: {"passage": "\"Safe Harbor\" Statement: Statements in this press release relating to future plans, expectations, beliefs, intentions and prospects, including our expectations that we will not need to raise capital to support our new large-scale AI contracts signed in Q3, our intention not to issue additional bonds in calendar year 2026, growing demand for cloud computing increasing our revenue growth, expected future total revenues, expected future total Cloud revenue, expected future non-GAAP earnings per share, and expected future capital expenditures are \"forward-looking statements\" and are subject to material risks and uncertainties."}
request.system: Read the issuer's SEC filing passage as evidence. Classify only an explicit forward direction for company-wide capital expenditures. Exclude liquidity, general plans to invest, historical spending, depreciation expense, segment spending, and dollar range forecasts. Use up, down, flat or none. Return the target fiscal year only if explicitly stated, otherwise null. For a positive direction, copy the exact continuous evidence from the passage, including the spending measure, direction and any year. Give confidence from 0 to 1. An unclear scope means company_wide=false.
